name: Alsónána (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alsónána (a blue shield with a church, an ear of grain and a bunch of grapes on a green base, bordered in yellow) below the name ALSÓNÁNA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
